thread:
jamie_oncall: heads-up — got an alert for 500s on the canary. when I dug into the nginx access logs I found Authorization header snippets logged. looks like Bearer tokens were partially captured.

jamie_oncall: sample (redacted) — `GET /api/v1/submit 200 - "Authorization: Bearer ****abc123def"`

alex_sre: is that prod or staging?

jamie_oncall: initially from staging-canary in eu-west, but the request path matches a mobile client flow that explains the token format. not sure if any prod hosts have the same logger.

maria_sec: tagging this P0 for data exposure triage. need to know: 1) were these customer tokens or internal service tokens, 2) full scope (which hosts/buckets), 3) whether any consumer API keys are present. if customer tokens, we'll rotate and notify.

priya_dev: I can grep across the cluster quickly. logs are aggregated into s3://redwood-logs/ingest/nginx/year=2026/month=03/day=17/. running `aws s3 cp` locally to pull a couple files.

dev-bot: incident created INC-2026-233 in #incidents and assigned to @jamie_oncall, @maria_sec, @alex_sre

alex_sre: priority checklist: isolate hosts that wrote the offending logs, snapshot those logs, run a full search for "Authorization:" header occurrences, and stop the logger from including headers.

nate_platform: access note — the logs S3 prefix has cross-team read access for infra and support via a role. I'll temporarily tighten the S3 policy and audit who accessed the prefix in the last 72h.

priya_dev: quick grep command I'm running across pulled logs:
```
grep -n "Authorization: Bearer" ./nginx-logs-*.log | head -50
```
found ~8 hits in staging-canary-2 and 2 hits in staging-canary-5. none in the small prod sample I pulled so far.

maria_sec: good. for each hit, determine token type: if starts with `usr_` or matches customer token regex then treat as customer. else internal service token. also check if full token length was logged or just a suffix/prefix.

jamie_oncall: all hits show only trailing 6-8 chars and the rest masked by our lib, e.g. `****abc123`. so partials only.

maria_sec: partial exposure still counts. action items: (A) rotate any tokens that were fully present (none so far), (B) enforce immediate redaction change to strip entire header before writing, (C) try to determine if anyone pulled those logs externally.

rosie_comms: @maria_sec do we need to prepare an external customer comms? if yes I'll draft and route for approvals.

maria_sec: not yet. if we confirm only staging and tokens are not usable (partial suffix only) then internal postmortem + customer-facing FAQ ready if needed. we should assume worst-case until audit completes.

alex_sre: I pushed a hotfix to the logging lib to fully strip Authorization header in all envs — PR in infra-logging repo. link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-logging/pull/789 (going to canary now).

priya_dev: confirming PR applied to staging-canary-*. no further writes with header content observed after 15:10 UTC.

nate_platform: S3 access tightened and access logs enabled for that prefix. I also put a deny policy on public access keys. audit in progress.

jamie_oncall: next: do we rotate any keys now? suggestion: rotate internal service tokens that match pattern svc-* for the canary hosts, and run a validity check for customer tokens — but looks like none found.

maria_sec: agree rotate service tokens for canary hosts and any role/keys with read access to the logs. open a ticket for key rotation and link to INC-2026-233.

rosie_comms: draft external comms prepared in-drive in case we need it. will wait for sign-off.

alex_sre: one more check — run a broader grep across prod app logs and ingress logs. Priya/nate can you run that overnight and post results?

priya_dev: will run scheduled job and upload results to the incident thread (artifacts/). will redact any token-like strings in the artifact.

maria_sec: final note on comms: if we later find customer tokens were included and active, we will notify impacted customers within 72 hours per policy. otherwise mark as internal incident and include mitigations.

jamie_oncall: summarizing actions done: 1) hotfix to strip headers deployed to staging-canary 2) S3 prefix permission tightened 3) token grep across staging done — partial suffixes only 4) rotation ticket created for service tokens 5) audit of S3 access started.

rosie_comms: thanks — keep me posted. I'll only escalate externally if you mark "external_comm_required: true". :white_check_mark: 

maria_sec: +1 for that plan. if overnight grep shows nothing in prod and no external download activity, we close as internal with postmortem.

jamie_oncall: closing oncall thread for now, will update INC-2026-233 with artifacts and next steps. thank you all. :pray:
